thread:
Clara (People Ops): Noticed an alert from the hiring dashboard 10: the weekly scorecard import reported schema mismatches and skipped ~9 debrief rows. Can we triage?
Ben (Recruiter): I pulled the import log. It looks like our recruiter-importer script introduced a new field name 'exec_impact' while the dashboard expects 'impact'. The importer didn't fail loudly, just skipped non-matching keys.
Hao (Hiring Manager): That explains why two candidates in the last hiring panel had blank impact scores. We used those in the leveling discussion.
Ravi (Recruiting Ops): Sample from the CSV header: impact,communication -> but the importer created exec_impact instead. Quick fix: map exec_impact -> impact for this week's ingest. I'll run a backfill.
ops-bot: :information_source: Backfill job queued by Ravi. Job id: 2026-03-23-bf-09.
Ben (Recruiter): I'm pushing a small PR to make the importer validate headers and reject unknown fields with a warning so we catch this before export.
Clara (People Ops): Good. Also let's add a one-line checklist in the recruiter playbook: "Run header-validate on exports before submitting to analytics". We should avoid manual renames in the scorecard UI unless coordinated.
Hao (Hiring Manager): For immediate hiring committee: please re-run the calibrations after backfill. I held off offers until numbers are restored.
Ravi (Recruiting Ops): Backfill complete. ops-bot shows 9 rows recovered. Posting a diff to #people-ops.
ops-bot: :white_check_mark: Backfill completed successfully. 9 rows restored.
Ben (Recruiter): PR 1834 opened: importer now validates headers and logs mismatches as errors. Will add a small unit test too.
Clara (People Ops): Action items: 1) Ben: merge header-validation PR and add unit test. 2) Ravi: monitor next daily import and add slack alert for header mismatches. 3) Clara: add playbook note and a 10-min refresher for interviewers about proper field names.
Hao (Hiring Manager): Thanks all. Minor ask: can People Ops create a 1-page quick-ref for interviewers about using the numeric fields vs comments? We're seeing too many verbal-only notes.
Clara (People Ops): Yes, I'll draft that and circulate. Closing loop once PR merges and the next import validates cleanly.
